parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The name of the filter that is used to filter out unwanted service groups. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas list-groups --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --filter foo --workspace-id 123000 --traffic-mode auto --sort CreateTime --order desc --labels key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/groups --region cn-hangzhou --Order desc --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --Filter foo --TrafficMode auto --WorkspaceId 123000 --Sort CreateTime --Labels '{"key":"example-string"}' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
